_readme: Evidence record for Tier 1 reviews. A numeric score is computed and shown ONLY when all six criteria have a rating, evidence_complete is true and second_review is true (see docs/editorial-review-scoring-rubric.md). Ratings are 0-5 or null (not assessed). Never use null as a low score. Notes are paraphrased; every rating needs a source URL and the date checked.

bet365-casino-gb.licence_line: UKGC account 55149 · bet365.com listed as active domain

offer.headline: Up to 500 free spins (new players)
offer.detail: Needs at least GBP 10 lifetime deposits, claimed within 30 days of registering; the offer page states winnings from these spins carry no wagering requirement and closes to new customers on 25 Nov 2026. Full conditions apply.

terms.note: Offer page sets out deposit minimum, claim window, reveal schedule, eligible games and close date, and states the wagering position for winnings.

payments.note: Method-specific minimum and maximum withdrawal amounts and processing estimates are published; verification is required first. Estimates only, not transaction-tested.

safer.note: Account limits, time-outs and self-exclusion are documented in the Great Britain help centre, alongside operator-set affordability limits.

complaints.note: Published route: customer service, escalation to a senior team member, then IBAS after eight weeks or if the customer disagrees with the final response.

licence.note: The UKGC register links the casino business to account 55149 and lists bet365.com as an active domain; terms identify the contracting entity per product.

usability.note: Not assessed: no structured check of how easy key terms and controls are to find.

red_flags.text: UKGC regulatory settlement: GBP 343,035 paid in lieu of a financial penalty by Hillside (UK Gaming) ENC after historic anti-money-laundering and social-responsibility failures.

betfair-casino-great-britain-review.licence_line: UKGC account 39435 · remote casino licence active

offer.headline: 50 free spins at 10p, then 50 more after a qualifying GBP 10 spend
offer.detail: Seen on the offer page: opt-in code needed, new customers only, spins expire 7 days after award, e-wallet deposits do not qualify for the second set. Wagering and any win cap were not stated on the pages seen and the full promotional terms could not be opened, so treat the conditions as unverified.

terms.note: General terms are well structured with a plain-language summary, but the offer pages leave wagering, win caps and withdrawability of spin winnings unstated.

payments.note: Withdrawal timing and verification rules are documented; limits and fees for other methods were not readable in the sources opened.

safer.note: Deposit and loss limits, reminders, time-outs and self-exclusion are documented; the terms address GAMSTOP.

complaints.note: Clear steps through the complaints team to IBAS for UK customers, with stated acknowledgement and final-response timeframes.

licence.note: Footer names the licensed entities and UKGC account numbers, but the casino subdomain was not listed under the licensee in the domain register page checked.

usability.note: Support hub is clear, but offer conditions are not shown on the offer pages. No formal accessibility testing.

red_flags.text: UKGC settlement following a licence review: GBP 2,000,000 paid in lieu of a financial penalty, combined across four licensees including Betfair Casino Limited, for remote customer-interaction failings.

notes: Verify the exact casino domain against the UKGC register before relying on this profile: only www.betfair.com appeared under account 39435 in the page checked.

william-hill-casino-great-britain-review.licence_line: UKGC account 39225 · remote casino licence active

offer.headline: Current offer not verified
offer.detail: The casino and Vegas offer pages could not be opened during this check, so no amount or conditions are claimed.

terms.note: General terms are versioned and dated (2026/1.4, 30 Sep 2026) and clear on entity, maximum-winnings limits and a dormant-account fee; bonus-abuse clauses give the operator wide discretion. Offer-specific terms were not reviewed.

payments.note: Terms cover verification, own-name deposits and withdrawal availability; the help centre lists withdrawal articles but limits, times and fees were not visible.

safer.note: Deposit limits, mandatory reality checks, time-outs, group-wide self-exclusion, product blocking and GAMSTOP are documented; loss limits are not mentioned.

complaints.note: Three-step route: live chat, second-opinion team, then IBAS if unresolved after eight weeks. Response times per step were not seen.

licence.note: Terms name the entity, company number and UKGC account; the register confirms a remote casino licence. Group entities differ between terms and register, and the casino domain listing was not confirmed.

usability.note: Not assessed: the casino and Vegas pages could not be opened.

red_flags.text: UKGC record settlement of GBP 19.2m across William Hill group businesses (WHG (International) Ltd paid GBP 12.5m) for safer-gambling and anti-money-laundering failures.
UKGC financial penalty of GBP 82,687 on WHG (International) Ltd for a customer-identification condition breach; self-reported.
